name: Big Book Small Book
look: Two closed hardcover books with dark red covers and cream page edges, seen from the side on a white background. A very thick book sits on the left and a thin one sits on the right.
use: Compares the size of two related things. The thick book is labeled with something long or bloated and the thin book with its tiny counterpart, such as a huge rulebook next to the rules anyone actually follows.
slots: the long or bloated thing (thick book, left)
the short or tiny thing (thin book, right)
describe: thick book next to a thin book
huge red hardcover beside a tiny skinny one
two books one fat and one small for comparison
giant book and little book on a white background
big heavy volume compared to a slim booklet
